description: Individual monitoring-station readings (监测站点数据) within one Chinese city — every station's AQI, pollutant concentrations and quality rating, with station name and coordinates. Use this for neighborhood-level detail within a city, e.g. "which part of Shanghai has the worst air right now" or "list the air monitoring stations in Beijing". Accepts an English or Chinese city name.

city.description: City name, English or Chinese, e.g. "Shanghai", "上海市".
